segments.comment: A debug dwarvish Valkyrie creates a tame saddled horse, mounts it by force, and fills the rest of the level with 1000 peaceful jackals. Dying to a wished wand of death zapped at herself and saving bones makes dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_BONES) look for a square for the horse: enexto() and rloc(RLOC_ERR|RLOC_NOMSG) both fail on the full level, so rloc() prints its impossible() diagnostic. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
